# quota-pacer v1.0.8

## 更新内容

### 中文

- 修复 Codex 等多窗口套餐下打分偏向 5 小时短窗口的问题：现在会同时评估账号名下的所有配额窗口（例如 5 小时、24 小时、7 天、30 天），并取其中最紧张的窗口作为该账号的最终打分依据，不再固定只看短窗口。
- 打分与展示架构从"仅短窗口+长窗口两个固定字段"扩展为支持任意数量的配额窗口，管理页 Pacing 表格与写入日志同步展示每个窗口各自的剩余量与重置时间。
- 任一窗口配额耗尽都会使该账号打分归零并降权，不会因为其他窗口尚有余量而被误判为可用。
- 无需修改任何配置，更新后自动生效；已有缓存证据会在下一轮探测时自动补齐新窗口信息。

### English

- Fixed a bias where multi-window plans (e.g. Codex) were scored mostly by their 5-hour window. All quota windows on an account (5h/24h/7d/30d, etc.) are now evaluated together, and the tightest window is used as the account's final pacing score.
- The scoring and display architecture moved from a fixed short/long two-field model to support any number of quota windows; the management Pacing table and audit logs now show remaining quota and reset time per window.
- Any single depleted window now zeroes out and deprioritizes the account, instead of being masked by remaining quota in other windows.
- No configuration change is required; the update takes effect automatically. Existing cached evidence will be refreshed with the new per-window data on the next probe cycle.
